checklist.note: No text steering the reading model; docs are plain usage instructions.
Token/URL only used to call the same org's own Tooling API endpoint, nothing sent elsewhere.
No embedded key/token; token is resolved at runtime via `sf org display`.

Anon Apex execution allows arbitrary DML/DDL-like mutation against the connected org; script explicitly calls this out ('Anonymous Apex can run DML — that is intentional') but it is real destructive-capability reach with no confirmation gate.
Plain bash + python3, fully readable, no encoded blobs.
curl only targets the org's own instanceUrl resolved from `sf org display`, not a third-party host.

Runs `SF_TEMP_SHOW_SECRETS=true sf org display` to pull the live access token into a shell variable, printed/parsed via grep rather than the CLI's own --json field access; stated reason (auth for curl) is legitimate but it's a real credential materialization worth noting.
No sudo, no persistence, no profile/cron edits.
